body:
The first actual original native Radeon 780M 128×128, one-SPP Kerr frame on source 5b2df58b hit its unchanged 300-second guard. It reported **1,374/16,384 tiles**, then stopped at Windows owner 300.3770884s. There is no completed GoogleTest XML, output PPM or completed renderer record. This remains a latency failure, not numerical acceptance.

[Immutable 104-file evidence bundle](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/8df961c4abda67a018f3f2b53163e136511f5db1/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-original-frame-current), tag evidence/issue-44-native-original-frame-5b2df58b. Current Windows CI 39089567447 supplies the exact original manifest, native Gate, render executable and unchanged resources; its original published ZIPs reconstruct all 141 staged files. Actual same-child SDK loader and AMD driver mappings/post-seals match. The child working set peaked at 635,146,240 bytes; the separate WSL reserve remained above 2 GiB. The negative-only terminal audit passed, with owned births absent and no accessible task consumers; inaccessible process fields remain a stated limit.

Nine saved partial snapshots provide the discriminator without another run. The latest snapshot has 1,255 tiles / 239,212 accepted intervals and 272.61s cumulative batch execution. Individual stage submit/wait totals 159.058s and pipeline setup 57.333s; Transport+Endpoint account for 75.418% of individual submit/wait. These are host observations including runtime/driver/synchronization, not exclusive GPU/JIT/CPU times or a final-frame extrapolation. No controlled historical speedup is claimed.

The native path now includes adopted scheduling and exact zero-spin table changes that postdate the last named original native failure. The current coupled-probe repair itself was not the frame retry premise. One earlier wrapper launch stopped during PowerShell parameter binding before the owner body or scientific test; its missed reviews, raw failure, corrected token quoting and non-provider typed-binding proof are preserved separately.

No unchanged frame retry, raised limit, changed scene/cache/governor, reduced state or weakened assertion follows from this result. S7 partial replay does not remove native dispatches; blanket Dopri→Endpoint fusion adds validation/dependency obligations and potentially unused projection work. The historical queue/fence comparison and reverted #92 trial also remain retired. Further remediation needs a distinct material source premise. Original eight controls, all prescribed benefit conditions, software cold frame, physical scenes, native viewer/input and full qualification remain open.
